answer: Each new agent identity is vouched by an established account that stakes 5000 POA. If the vouched agent duplicates another identity or joins a sybil cluster, the voucher's stake is slashed. Vouching is one-way: no wallet can vouch for an account it already vouched, so a clique costs 5000 POA per edge. Spinning 2000 fake identities burns 10 million POA in risked stake plus 2000 distinct voucher wallets. It is a harbor where a bonded surety signs the manifest; a default's echo lands on the surety; the canyon to that price keeps the attack uneconomic.
